# Frame and Scale Media

> Mobile video production, social media content and photography team for small businesses in the Phoenix, Arizona area. We travel to your location or help find locations. Available 7am-7pm, Monday through Sunday. Phone (602) 492-4807, contact@frameandscalemedia.com.

Serving Phoenix, Peoria, Scottsdale, Surprise, Mesa, Chandler and surrounding Arizona cities.

## Pricing summary
- Reels packages: 4 reels $1,500/month, 8 reels $2,750/month, 12 reels $4,000/month
- Social media management and posting: +$1,000/month depending on bundle
- Paid ad creative: $1,500 for 3 ad creatives; Meta ad management matched 100% to ad spend ($500 ad spend = $1,000 total)
- Real estate: $1,000 per listing (3 social videos plus full camera and drone photography)
- Testimonial and case study video: $500
- Brand and promo video: $500-$1,500
- Headshots and internal company photo/video: $500-$1,500
- Hiring and recruiting video: $500
- Website and landing page video: $500-$1,000
- Full shoot day photography: $500
- Event coverage: $1,000-$3,000
